context: Sho-young plays with a dropped soccer ball; chats with Riku-teen.
purpose: Two friends sharing simple physical play.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 陸くん、ボール、ずいぶん遠く動く!
lines.en: Riku, the ball — it's going so far!
lines.style: Wide-eyed wonder. Quick bright attack on the first words. Breathless, almost amazed. Pointing with voice. Genuine child delight, no affectation.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 上手いな、上がってきたで、お前!
lines.en: That's pretty good. You're really improving.
lines.style: Warm encouragement with a slight smile in the voice. Casual, natural — not overpraising. Small note of genuine surprise at Sho's progress. Relaxed pace.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 初心者と比べたら、進歩した?
lines.en: Have I gotten better compared to when I started?
lines.style: Genuine curiosity. Soft, searching tone — really wants to know. Not fishing for more praise. Slight upward lilt at the end, like he's asking a real question of someone he trusts.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 次第に、力、ついてきたな。
lines.en: Yeah, you're getting stronger little by little.
lines.style: Quiet affirmation. Steady, unhurried pace. Genuine observation beneath the words. The tone of someone who's actually been paying attention. Slight nod in the voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 練習、重ねて、もっとうまく!
lines.en: I'm going to keep practicing and get even better!
lines.style: Small but determined voice. Soft intensity — not loud, but resolute. Quick pace on the first part, then slightly deliberate on the resolve. Earnest, no bravado.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.en: You've really got guts, you know?
lines.style: Animated and warm. Genuine brightness in the voice. Light, affirming tone — real respect beneath it. Quick, energetic delivery. The kind of encouragement that lands.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: Thank you for cheering me on!
lines.style: Sincere gratitude. Soft, genuine tone — not performing thankfulness. Small, warm voice. Slight closing exhale, like relief and happiness mixed together.
